description: Spec routes no resource method declares, each with the reason. tests/test_route_coverage.py fails on a route that is neither declared nor listed here, on an entry whose route a method now declares or the spec no longer has, and on an entry with no reason. A reason starting 'not yet implemented' names the issue that will implement the route, so that work shows up as entries removed from this list.

routes.GET /object/item-collections/{id}: Documented, but bw serve answers 400, so the library does not offer it (upstream/route-decisions.json, behaviour; decided on #21 - spec vs bw serve differences).
routes.GET /send/list: Alias of GET /list/object/send, which Sends.list uses; bw serve answers the alias with every Send's key empty and an accessUrl ending /undefined, so the Sends it lists cannot be opened (tests/fixtures/serve/sends-list.json).
